flashlight.name: Flashlight
flashlight.desc: Old, heavy, and the batteries never last. [F] to toggle.

battery.name: Battery
battery.desc: Restores flashlight charge. Used automatically when the light dies.

plank.name: Plank
plank.desc: Barricade a closed door [B]. It will not hold forever.

fuse.name: Fuse
fuse.desc: A spare ceramic fuse for the fuse box in the laundry room.

key_cellar.name: Cellar Key
key_cellar.desc: Heavy and cold. The tag reads CELLAR in careful capitals.

key_study.name: Study Key
key_study.desc: A small brass key tied with string. "A.W. - STUDY".

key_master.name: Master Bedroom Key
key_master.desc: The ribbon on this key is faded pink.

key_attic.name: Attic Key
key_attic.desc: Dusty. Someone scratched a little cat on the bow.

key_front.name: Front Door Key
key_front.desc: The big brass key to the front door. The door is also chained.

bolt_cutters.name: Bolt Cutters
bolt_cutters.desc: Strong enough for a chain. Loud enough to wake anything.

car_keys.name: Car Keys
car_keys.desc: Keys to the car in the garage. A plastic fob shaped like a fish.

car_battery.name: Car Battery
car_battery.desc: Heavy. It should still hold a charge.

gas_can.name: Gas Can
gas_can.desc: Half full. It sloshes when you move.

crowbar.name: Crowbar
crowbar.desc: Could pry boards off a window.

rope.name: Rope
rope.desc: Long enough to climb down from somewhere high.

wrench.name: Pipe Wrench
wrench.desc: For stubborn bolts. There is a grate in the coal cellar...

valve_wheel.name: Valve Wheel
valve_wheel.desc: A red iron wheel. It fits a drain valve.

music_box.name: Ellie's Music Box
music_box.desc: A little box with a dancer inside. It is missing its winding key.

ribbon.name: Red Ribbon
ribbon.desc: A child's hair ribbon. It smells faintly of lavender.

easy.label: Easy
easy.blurb: It moves slowly and loses track of you. You can struggle free twice.

normal.label: Normal
normal.blurb: It searches rooms, remembers where you were and sometimes waits for you.

hard.label: Hard
hard.blurb: Faster, sharper, checks hiding spots and punishes repeated tricks.

nightmare.label: Nightmare
nightmare.blurb: Relentless. It lies, it waits, it never lets you breathe.
